response.overview: After Us is an anthological post-apocalyptic series. This queer coded episode follows a bereaved father as he takes shelter in an old church, dealing with old traumas, and haunting memories of a past life. As he copes with encroaching loneliness, he discovers another uninfected human on the other side of the road. Unable to meet face to face due to a zombie infestation below, the two attempt to form a connection through through any possible way. As they learn about one another, they begin to form a relationship with each other. As they do, they find the undead horde below making similar connections with one another. As the road clears, the two attempt to meet, with disastrous results.
response.title: After Us
